column1: # Decision class of a path, one `class<TAB>glob` line each; the first matching line wins, a path matching none is D1,
# and a change takes the highest class of its paths. Globs are bash patterns where `*` also crosses `/`.
# Paths are matched relative to the root (`./` and `//` removed); .agents/harness/debt.tsv is left out of a diff
# while rows are only appended to it.
# D2: the harness itself, agent instructions and tool config at any depth (CLAUDE.local.md, opencode.json(c), tool
# ignore files such as .cursorignore), CI config at any depth (for example .github, .gitlab-ci.yml, .gitlab,
# .woodpecker, .gitea, .forgejo, appveyor.yml, cloudbuild.yaml, .semaphore: a CI system missing here is D1 until a
# row is added), git hooks, git files that hide or redirect paths (ignore, attributes, submodules), editor config,
# secrets and security-sensitive code. D0: docs only.
